Coram : DEEPAK GUPTA*, ANIRUDDHA BOSE
Specific Relief Act, 1963 – s.16(c) – Performance of the essential terms of the contract – Predecessor-in-interest of the appellants entered into an agreement to sell the suit land with predecessor-in-interest of the respondents for total consideration of Rs. this Rs.1000/- was paid as earnest money at the time of execution of agreement to sell – The possession of the land was handed over to the predecessor-in-interest of the respondents (vendee) – Since there was some litigation with regard to the property it was agreed between the parties
Decision Date : 11-09-2019 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7424/2011 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
